clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder puts a novice warlock through a final trial. With his recovered Bloodstone Choker, you draw a voidwalker into a hidden circle and force it to submit.

Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, forgotten catacombs run beyond the watchful gaze of the Silver Hand and Kirin Tor magistrates. Gakin the Darkbinder teaches novice warlocks that dark magic demands more than channeling power; they must also dominate otherworldly beings. You have recovered Gakin's stolen Bloodstone Choker from Surena Caledon. Now he asks you to call a voidwalker into the summoning circle beneath the tavern.

A voidwalker will not bargain with you. The power in the Bloodstone Choker opens a rift and draws the shadow creature into the mortal world. You must batter it with magic and force until its will breaks, proving you can command it. Once defeated, the voidwalker's essence binds to you, giving you a durable, shadowy protector that can endure punishment in the battles ahead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By retrieving my choker and besting Surena, you've proven that you're at least as capable as she was.
With that said, I can tell you're direly in need of training. You can manage the flows of magic, yes, but being a warlock is much more than that.

I will show you how to command a voidwalker, but before I can, you must call one forth at a summoning circle and subdue it using whatever weapons—physical and magical—you have at your disposal. Use the magic of this choker at the summoning circle below.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I cannot show you how to control a voidwalker until you have overtaken one.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did better than I expected, friend, but as well as I'd hoped. Now, you can learn to command your subjugated voidwalker, an ally you will find valuable in the trials that are sure to stand before you.
I have nothing more to teach you at the present, but I am far from done with you, friend.
